text: While we work on this month's story, I hope you enjoyed Nagi's Decision as much as Reo and Isagi did ❤️
Kirishima is proving how strong he is. How long can he last against a tickle attack?
Meliodas was always a good partner for Ban. We need more friendships like this!
I was looking through some old illustrations and forgot we had drawn Zuko a while ago. I think it's time to make a version based on the latest movie 🔥
Happy Monday, everyone! I wonder who Asta is fighting... but it looks like he's losing.
I read that Phantom Busters is getting an anime adaptation. I'm dying to see Mogari!

I think I should start writing the next comic.
It'll be our first time doing My Adventures with Superman... and you'll see who Clark Kent ends up with.
Sung Jin-Woo has your dessert ready. It's nice being with him.
And so Cabba's intense training continues. I wonder what Vegeta will teach him next.

Our dear Nakamura can't stop thinking about what Hirose would do.
